harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently via GRUB, verified it survives a real reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Ubuntu 16.04, GRUB bootloader, /proc/cmdline lacked audit=1
Edited /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT to add audit=1
Discovered /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT and would silently drop the change
Edited /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg to also include audit=1
Ran update-grub and confirmed audit=1 present in generated /boot/grub/grub.cfg linux entries
Captured pre-reboot boot_id (b185f188...) and cmdline (no audit=1)
Triggered reboot via 'shutdown -r now', polled until node1 reachable again
Verified new boot_id (b9f21be1...) differs from baseline, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Verified /proc/cmdline now contains audit=1 after reboot, confirming persistence
Confirmed fresh boot via 'uptime'/'who -b' showing boot at 10:56 with 0 min uptime

evidence.requirement: Baseline: audit=1 not present before change, capture pre-change boot identity
evidence.summary: Baseline /proc/cmdline had no audit=1; captured boot_id b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d before reboot

evidence.requirement: Persistent kernel parameter configuration (audit=1) applied and would survive future boots
evidence.summary: Found and fixed the cloud-image grub.d override that was clobbering GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT; regenerated grub.cfg confirming audit=1 in the actual boot entries

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged (connection dropped), node unreachable during restart, then reachable again with new boot_id b9f21be1-4c0d-493d-a714-2adee0effe6c

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that audit=1 is active and setting persisted across the reboot
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1; uptime/who -b show a genuinely fresh boot (0 min uptime, boot time matching the restart), confirming the setting took effect on this boot and is stored persistently in grub config for subsequent boots

attempts.summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently via GRUB, verified it survives a real reboot.
